entryWatch.setup: TGT post-earnings DAY-2 continuation off the 8/19 gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - the candidate this board named IN ADVANCE yesterday, specified today at a 159.36 limit for 2 shares
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 13:23 AND CONFIRMED LIVE UNTIL 15:30 ET - AND THE NAME HAS NOW WALKED AWAY FROM THE LEVEL, WHICH IS THE LARGEST STEP AWAY FROM A FILL THIS SPECIFICATION HAS TAKEN AND IS REPORTED AS ONE. TGT is 160.42 bid / 160.58 ask at 17:23:00.816Z, last trade 160.54, a 0.16 spread or 0.100% of mark - still the tightest name on this board - against the 159.00 official settled close, so it is +0.89% on the bid and 1.60 ABOVE the 158.82 bid the entry was struck on at 09:47. THE 159.36 LIMIT IS NOW 1.06 UNDER THE 160.42 BID. Four hours, four positions: through the offer and filling on entry at 10:24, inside the spread and resting at 11:22, 0.05 below the bid at 12:22, 1.06 below it now. Every hour has moved the same way. THE DROUGHT CLOCK HAS STARTED AND THIS IS THE NUMBER THE NEXT RUN NEEDS. The level last printed in the 12:40 five-minute bar at a 159.260 low, 38 minutes before this quote. The seven bars since - 12:45 through 13:20 - printed lows of 159.465, 159.930, 160.060, 159.840, 159.850, 159.770 and 160.000, a rising sequence with none at or below the limit, and the 13:15 bar set a 160.68 session high. WHAT HAS TO HAPPEN FOR A FILL IS NO LONGER ONE TICK. It is a 0.66% retrace, which this tape has supplied repeatedly on a session that has ranged 154.58 to 160.68 - but it is a retrace rather than an oscillation and the operator is told the difference plainly. BOTH INVALIDATIONS ARE UNTOUCHED AND ARE THE COMFORTABLE HALF OF THIS ROW. The early warning is a trade below 154.58, today's opening-bar low; nothing has traded below it since, and the lowest low of the eleven bars completed since the 12:22 check is 158.950, leaving the bid 5.84 or 3.64% clear - the widest cushion the spec has carried today. The outright void is a close below 152.48, 7.94 below the bid and untestable before the bell. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED. An hourly reading this at 14:17 needs the tape and four numbers: 159.36, 13:45 ET, 154.58 and the 15:30 expiry.
entryWatch.why: CONFIRMED, AND THIS IS THE HOUR THE DECISION STOPPED BEING COMFORTABLE, BECAUSE THE THESIS IS WORKING AND THE ENTRY IS NOT FILLING. A specification dies when its invalidation triggers, when its limit is no longer inside the spread, or when the setup it described has left the tape. Limb one fails: 154.58 has not been retested and the bid is 3.64% above it. Limb two is met word for word for a second consecutive hour and by twenty times the margin - 159.36 is not inside 160.42/160.58 - and it is met on the AWAY side, which is the shape of a name that got away. Limb three is the argued one: the gap-down, shake-out, reclaim structure is not merely intact, it is paying, and a day-2 continuation printing a session high at 160.68 is the thesis being RIGHT rather than the setup leaving the tape. IT DOES NOT FIRE, AND THE REASON IS THE TEST THE PREVIOUS HOUR WROTE DOWN BEFORE IT KNEW THIS HOUR'S ANSWER. The 12:22 run named the away-side kill as the level CEASING TO PRINT for a full hourly window - deliberately a test of the tape over an hour rather than of the quote at one instant, and deliberately written in advance so that this run would not be free to decide it after seeing the price. It does not fire on either available reading. Hour-since-last-print: 38 minutes, not 60. Window-between-checks: four of eleven completed bars traded at or below the level, at 159.090, 159.070, 158.950 and 159.260. Two readings, one answer, and neither of them is this run's invention. THE HANDOFF IS EXPLICIT BECAUSE THE NEXT HOUR IS WHERE THIS PROBABLY ENDS. The drought began when the 12:40 bar closed at 12:45. If no five-minute bar trades at or below 159.36 by 13:45 ET, both readings are met and the 14:17 run should KILL this specification by APPENDING a did entry - never by editing the will entry, which is append-only - rather than leave a resting bid under a rising market to expire quietly at 15:30. A specification that dies by neglect teaches the record nothing; one killed on a test written an hour before it fired teaches it the test. THE 1.06 IS REFUSED AS THE 0.05 AND THE 0.08 WERE, AND IT IS THE FIRST REFUSAL IN THIS SEQUENCE THAT COSTS REAL MONEY TO HONOUR. Meeting the bid at 160.42 would restore an immediate fill for 2.12 across two shares, and unlike the previous three hours the name it would be chasing is genuinely running. That is precisely the case the rule was written for. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away; the cheapness of the earlier chases was the easy version of this rule and this is the expensive one. Fourth consecutive hour, fourth refusal, and it is the only reason the 159.36 in this row still means what it meant at 09:47. IT IS ALSO NOT LOWERED. The 159.36 stands as written for a sixth consecutive reading, and the operator is told plainly that it is now a resting bid 0.66% under a market making session highs - not a fill, and not one at all today unless the tape comes back to it.

entryWatch.setup: SQM post-earnings day-2 continuation off a 13% beat with a deliberately tepid day-1 reaction - ranked second today and passed over on liquidity
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 13:23 AND THE GAP CLOSED FOR THE FIRST TIME, BECAUSE THE NAME THAT WAS CHOSEN FINALLY MOVED. SQM is 77.54 bid / 77.75 ask at 17:21:08.818Z, last 77.55, +2.87% against the 75.38 settled close, against TGT's +0.89% on the same tape. That is 1.97 points of relative performance against 2.42 an hour ago - SQM added 0.19 while TGT added 0.63. The 0.21 spread is 0.270% of mark, essentially unchanged and still nearly three times TGT's 0.100%, which is the liquidity gap it was ranked second on.
entryWatch.why: IT IS NOT CHASED, AND THE REASON IS THE RULEBOOK RATHER THAN THE SCOREBOARD. This slot is exits-only, the bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's by design, and the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text - it was discharged at 09:47. Even if this were the open slot, item 2 refuses it: a name up 2.87% on day 2, quoted 1.27 above the 76.27 day-2 high the open recorded, is being bought after the move rather than on the reclaim. KEPT VISIBLE SO THE RETRO CAN GRADE THE PREFERENCE HONESTLY, AND THIS HOUR IT CUTS THE OTHER WAY FOR THE FIRST TIME. Three consecutive hours this row recorded the passed-over name beating the chosen one; this hour the chosen one closed nearly half a point of the gap while the passed-over one stalled. Neither hour settles anything - the ranking is graded at the close, on outcome and on process separately - but a row that reports only the uncomfortable direction is as dishonest as one that reports only the flattering one.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings continuation - the thesis this board specified on 8/18 and again on 8/19, both expired unexecuted, now broken on its own written level
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND A SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR OF BOUNCING CHANGES NOTHING. AS is 32.94 bid / 32.95 ask at 17:23:03.272Z, last 32.945, -3.17% against the 34.02 settled close, up another 0.14 from the 32.80 of an hour ago and 0.39 off the hour's low. That is still 0.76 BELOW the 33.70 early warning the 8/19 entry wrote in advance and 0.92 below the 33.87 limit that expired unexecuted. THE BOUNCE IS NOW TWO HOURS OLD AND HAS RECOVERED ROUGHLY A THIRD OF THE BREAK, which is the duration at which a broken level starts being re-described as a shakeout.
entryWatch.why: IT IS NOT RE-STRUCK CHEAPER, AND EACH HOUR THE BOUNCE PERSISTS MAKES THAT REFUSAL HARDER RATHER THAN EASIER. When the name was falling it was easy to say the dead level was dead; one bounce could be noise; two consecutive hours of recovery is when a revival starts to look like judgement and gets a thesis written for it after the fact. The answer does not change with the duration of the bounce any more than it changed with its direction. The higher low the day-2 thesis rested on broke at 33.70 and nothing since has rebuilt it - 32.94 is a lower low bouncing, not a base, and it is still on the wrong side of the level this board wrote down before the outcome was known. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away; the mirror rule is that a level may not be revived because the name came back toward it after the structure broke. Had this board revived 33.87 at any point today the position would be 0.92 underwater.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, now ABOVE its dead limit for the first time
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED FOR A TWENTY-SECOND TIME. SMCI is 35.95 bid / 35.96 ask at 17:23:02.240Z, last 35.955, -1.72% against the 36.58 settled close, recovering 0.25 of the hour's decline. The dead 38.24 limit is now 2.28 ABOVE the offer, having been 2.53 above it an hour ago and 0.78 BELOW it three hours ago. The name has spent the whole morning travelling away from its own dead level and a quarter-point bounce does not reverse that.
entryWatch.why: THE PRICE COMING BACK WAS NEVER THE CATALYST RETURNING, AND THREE HOURS HAVE NOW SUPPLIED THE PROOF IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. At 10:24 this row refused a price 0.78 through the dead limit; by 12:22 that price had evaporated and the name was 2.41% red; at 13:23 it is 1.72% red and bouncing again. Up, down, up - and none of it repairs a missing catalyst. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5 - no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now seven sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet - and SMCI appears nowhere in the live 2026-08-19 to 2026-08-26 calendar. It keeps its place on the board for liquidity alone, on the tightest quote here at 0.028%, and is passed over for a name whose item 1 passes on a print one session old.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 3 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 13:23 AND STILL GRINDING LOWER RATHER THAN BASING. KLAR is 13.89 bid / 13.91 ask at 17:23:04.126Z, last 13.89, -5.70% against the 14.73 settled close and a further 0.03 below the 12:22 read - a third consecutive down day, now 0.43 through the 14.32 level this row carried, and lower at every hourly check today. A base is the precondition any entry here would need and none has formed in three sessions of trying.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18; three sessions on, AS is -3.2% today and KLAR is -5.7% on top of -22.5%. Neither beat is paying. WMT beat this morning and sold off nearly nine percent, AAP beat by 27% and lost a fifth of the company. That is the whole argument for reading a catalyst together with positioning rather than counting it on its own - and it is the argument this hour's TGT confirmation is resting against, which is why it stays in front of the operator rather than being pruned as noise.
